summary.basal_cap: The basal closure supplied in initial_mesh.npz is retained with shared connectivity and propagated by the same local 3-D image motion as the rest of the cavity surface.

uncertainty.basis: Range is a reconstruction sensitivity estimate based on cyclic tracking closure and residual image agreement; it is not a population confidence interval. Boundary dropout and basal-plane ambiguity remain incompletely represented.

diagnosis.finding: Image-driven closed-surface LV cavity EF is 22.0% (ED 125.8 mL at frame 2; ES 98.1 mL at frame 10), classified as severely_reduced by the pilot thresholds. The estimate is not near a pilot category boundary under the stated reconstruction range.
image_and_model_evidence: Sequential 3-D registration of the authoritative B-mode arrays produces a coherent contraction-relaxation trajectory while retaining the supplied initialization exactly.
Independently integrated closed-surface volumes decrease from 125.8 mL at ED to 98.1 mL at ES.
Median adjacent-frame image NCC changes from 0.951 before warping to 0.972 after warping.
differential_and_limits: This is a cavity-volume systolic-function estimate from research 3-D B-mode data, not a diagnosis of clinical heart failure or its cause.
Endocardial dropout, speckle decorrelation, basal valve-plane definition, and any foreshortening can bias EDV, ESV, and EF.
No infarction, ischemic cause, valve severity, filling pressure, hemodynamics, or tissue/material strain can be established from the supplied evidence.
Vertex indices provide geometric correspondence from image registration; they are not asserted to be myocardial material points.
